description: Buying-intent category queries for finding real estate agents and property professionals. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

prompts.text: How do I find a good real estate agent in my city for selling a home quickly?
Which real estate agents near me specialize in first-time buyers?
What's the best way to choose a listing agent when selling a condo?
Who are the top real estate agents near me with strong reviews and recent sales?
How do I find a buyer's agent who knows the area around good school districts?
Which local agents handle rental property purchases for small investors?
What should I ask a real estate agent before signing a listing agreement?
How do I find an agent who speaks Spanish and works with buyers in my area?
Which real estate agents near me have experience selling luxury homes?
What's the best way to find an agent for buying a vacation home on a budget?
Who are the best agents for selling an inherited house?
How do I find a property manager near me with fair fees and good reviews?
Which agents work with buyers who need a lower commission?
What's the best way to find an agent for relocating to a new city?
How do I choose between a large brokerage and a small local agent?
Which real estate agents near me help with downsizing for retirees?

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
